{{Short description|Spanish statistician}}
{{Use dmy dates|cs1-dates=ly|date=March 2023}}

{{Family name hatnote|lang=Spanish|Ibarrola|[[Muñoz]]}}
'''María del Pilar Ibarrola Muñoz''' (born 1944){{r|born}} is a Spanish statistician and [[stochastic control]] theorist, part of the early expansion of statistics into an academic discipline in Spain in the 1960s and 1970s.{{r|beio}} She was named professor of [[decision theory]] at [[Complutense University of Madrid]] in 1974,{{r|beio|boe74}} but soon after left for the [[University of La Laguna]], where she was named as University Professor.{{r|beio|boe76}} She returned to the professorship of decision theory at Complutense University in 1979.{{r|boe80}}

Ibarrola served as the third president of the [[Spanish Statistics and Operations Research Society]] (SEIO), from 1984 to 1986.{{r|pres}} She received the SEIO Medal in 2013.{{r|medal}}
